name: ChatView
description:
1. Task: adapt ChatView and its child components for the messenger/channel view, hiding all elements that make no sense in a group chat.
2. First attempt removed markup; user corrected it — nothing may be removed, task-only UI must stay in the DOM and be hidden with the `hidden` class, and full file contents were required.
3. Implemented a `channelMode` prop (default `false`) plus an `isChannel` / `isChannelChat` computed, threaded from `MessengerView` down to `ChatViewHeader`, `ChatSidebar` and `ChatSidebarNode`.
4. Hidden in channel mode: back arrow, breadcrumb/board, project selector, status, cost, tags, template and parent-inheritance flags, chat mode selector, Tasks/Settings actions, profiles, subtasks tree, browser session, timeline and AI logs.
5. `MessengerView` passes `channel-mode` to `ChatView` and keeps its members toggle in the `sidebar-actions` slot; `ChatIcon` already had the `channel` hashtag icon, so it was untouched.

I'll adapt the chat components for the messenger/channel view.
